characters.name: KARU KALLE
characters.description: Väike pruun karu koheva karva ja ümarate kõrvadega, kandmas siniseid kindaid ja kollast triibulist salli. Sõbralik ja rõõmus näoilme, suured mustad silmad. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: REBANE RIIN
characters.description: Väike oranž rebane koheva valge otsaga saba ja teravate kõrvadega, kandmas rohelist mütsi ja rohelisi kindaid. Naeratav ja energiline näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Lumise mäega mets
locations.description: A picturesque winter forest scene with a snowy hill sloping down to a flat snowy clearing. Tall pine trees dusted with fresh white snow in the background under a soft blue winter sky with gentle light. Bright white snow covers the ground with soft drifts. Cartoon style, clean and simple scene.

pages.text: KALLE JA RIIN ON VALGES METSAS.
pages.scene: Karu Kalle (cute brown bear in yellow striped scarf and blue mittens) and Rebane Riin (cute orange fox in green hat and green mittens) standing side-by-side in a beautiful snowy pine forest, smiling warmly at each other. Soft sunlight filters through snowy trees. Landscape composition.

Karu Kalle pulls a bright red wooden sled out from behind a snowy evergreen bush. Rebane Riin stands nearby, clapping her green-gloved hands with excitement. The snowy forest background stays consistent.
Karu Kalle pulls the red wooden sled up a gentle snowy hill, while Rebane Riin walks right next to him helping push. Small cute footprints stretch behind them in the white snow.
At the top of the snowy hill, Rebane Riin is happily seated at the front of the red wooden sled, holding its steering rope. Karu Kalle stands right beside the sled ready to climb on.
Karu Kalle sits down on the red wooden sled directly behind Rebane Riin. Both characters look forward down the hill with joyful, excited expressions, ready to slide.
Karu Kalle and Rebane Riin slide fast down the snowy hill on their bright red sled. Gentle snow splashes up around the sled. Their scarves flutter slightly, and both characters are laughing happily.
At the bottom of the hill, the red sled comes to a smooth, safe stop in a soft drift of fluffy white snow. Karu Kalle and Rebane Riin remain seated on the sled, laughing with pure delight.

Karu Kalle and Rebane Riin stand next to their red wooden sled at the foot of the hill, cheering with arms raised high in happiness. Beautiful bright winter lighting with gentle snowy pines in the background.
